prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Queen of Hearts COURT ILLUSTRATION ONLY, candidate A for a premium poker-slot deck. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target: preserve its engraved bone/ink/oxblood/worn-gold Queen identity and one-engraver hand. Create one upright waist-up Queen illustration, not a complete playing card and not a mirrored court. An elegant skeletal Queen with a clearly readable crowned skull, dark hair, restrained oxblood roses at her temples, bone hands holding a single dark red rose at chest, a black robe with a few broad worn-gold engraved seams. Flat frontal print artwork, no perspective. Crown and skull are large and silhouette-first; simplify small crosshatching so the face survives a 60×85 final card containing a mirrored pair. Bold black cavities, clear bone cheek/jaw shapes, short controlled engraving, only one rose at the chest. Composition: centered bust occupying 80% width, entire crown/hair/shoulders included, ends cleanly at waist near lower edge; generous transparent border. Palette: matte bone #E5D7B3, ink #11100F, oxblood #5A1520, restrained worn gold #B89148; no glowing highlights. Medium: nineteenth-century wood engraving with a premium tattoo-engraver economy, crisp contours, no blurry texture. Absolutely NO letters, Q, rank, suit symbols, hearts, pips, numbers, card indices, typography, border, frame, card substrate, extra character, skull decoration, dealer or mascot. This is a separate transparent PNG illustration layer for later deterministic vector/card-template composition. Output portrait 1024×1536 if possible, genuine transparent background with clean alpha; no checkerboard, no shadow outside artwork. Preserve exact original character family, but favor broad readable shapes over dense fine lines.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Queen of Hearts COURT ILLUSTRATION ONLY, candidate B for an actual 60×85px card. Input image 1 is the approved style family reference. Input image 2 is candidate A, the identity and pose reference. Make a second version preserving her exact skeletal queen, dark hair, crown, temple roses, bone hands and one dark-red rose at chest, one upright bust ending at waist. Change only readability: enlarge her skull by about 20%, broaden the dark eye sockets, simplify the robe to about eight broad ink shapes with a few narrow worn-gold seams, use fewer heavier crosshatch lines, a simpler crown with 3 readable points, fewer tiny jewels/filigree details. Make this feel confidently drawn by the SAME engraver rather than a different style. More clean pale bone around skull and hands; clear silhouettes at tiny display. Maintain palette matte bone #E5D7B3, black #11100F, oxblood #5A1520 and muted worn-gold #B89148. Flat front-view engraved illustration, centered full crown and shoulders, no perspective. Output one separate portrait illustration at 1024×1536. Genuine transparent background: remove ALL colored haze, glow, shadow and texture outside the silhouette; transparency all around and between illustration details, no rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard. Absolutely no letters, Q, rank, pips, indices, hearts/suit symbols, numbers, card border/frame/substrate, extra objects or characters. Do not generate the double-headed layout; it will be composed deterministically later with vector indices. Strong bold structural lines, no smooth digital paint, neon or gray blur.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: BLANK SHARED CARD MATERIAL, texture substrate only for the Muerta Poker deck. Input image 1 is the approved bone/ink/gold style reference, specifically its matte pale card paper. Render one full-frame flat scan of clean warm bone paper, color centered on #E5D7B3, very faint fine authentic fibers and a few tiny speckles. Uniform lighting, moderate pale center, only subtle natural wear at extreme edges. It must feel like uncoated archival card stock used by one engraver, high-end rather than dirty vintage. No folds, tears, burn marks, holes, stains, perspective, drop shadow, three-dimensional bevel, objects, ornaments, filigree, border or illustrations. Absolutely NO letters, pips, suit symbols, ranks, numbers or indices. No gradients that obscure ranks; no dark central mottling. The entire portrait rectangle is opaque paper. Intended base substrate for deterministic vector/template card composition at 512×720. Generate native 1024×1440 if possible (otherwise 1024×1536 portrait, with quiet edges suitable for cropping). This is material only, no Queen, Reaper or other character.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: GRIM REAPER JOKER ILLUSTRATION LAYER for Muerta Poker. Input image 1 is the CURRENT Grim Reaper identity reference: preserve its black hooded skeletal Reaper, bone hands and large curved scythe across upper-right; it is not a new dealer or mascot. Input image 2 is the approved engraved bone/ink/gold visual family. Input image 3 is Queen anchor candidate B: match the SAME engraver's line economy, flat pressed ink, robe/crown seam material, crisp silhouettes. Render one upright Reaper illustration, from head through robe and hands, a pronounced hood with a large unmistakable bone skull, black hollow sockets and tiny muted gold eye sparks, left hand across robe, right hand holding the scythe pole. Keep the body turned subtly as in current reference, scythe blade at the top and upper right. Retain restrained pale-gold seam and bone hands, simplify shadows into large black shapes; small detail subordinate. No red/blue digital shading; narrow worn-gold engraving and matte bone highlights. Composition centered on a transparent portrait canvas, entire blade/pole/hood/robe included within 8% clear safety margin, skull deliberately large enough to identify at 60×85px. An original hand-engraved print, same artist as Queen, dark gothic Día de los Muertos noir. Absolutely no letters, JOKER, rank, indices, pips, suit emblems, playing-card frame/border/substrate, extra flowers or other decorations, text, numeral, multiplier, logo, watermark, extra character. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette and around scythe gaps, no backdrop, colored haze, glow, shadow or checkerboard. Output portrait 1024×1536 if possible.
